svg.title: BS 546 15 A / SANS 164-1 socket-outlet (female), mating face, earth hole up
svg.desc: Schematic front view with the earth hole up. Two line or neutral holes at the bottom (sides not assigned by the cited sources) and a larger earth hole above the centre. Rings are female contacts. Proportions follow the SANS 164-1 figures: 25.4 mm between the line and neutral holes, 28.6 mm from each to the earth hole, 7.0 mm and 8.7 mm pins; the outline is schematic.
